when he come, and of the dignity, glory, and fulness of those blessings that should accrue to the human family, when he made his appearance among the children of men, they seemed to be entirely ignorant, as well as of the union and relationship to God which would be placed within the reach of the children of men to obtain through the medium of his atonement, and the redemption wrought out by him.…
